title: Tenant-level model-variant invocation enrichment and time-decayed cost facts
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: produce a set of curated, tenant-scoped facts that attribute GPU/token cost to model variants and routes while applying a time-decay weighting for long-running user journeys. This will enable billing-aligned cost dashboards, per-route efficiency recommendations, and per-tenant SLA anomaly detection.

Problem statement: current Console cost dashboards attribute spend at a coarse workspace level and do not reconcile model-variant switches, prefix cache savings, or multi-invocation user journeys. This makes it hard for Product and SRE to: 1) surface hotspots caused by expensive model variants, 2) estimate the marginal cost impact of model changes, and 3) provide fair tenant billing samples for Dedicated customers.

Deliverables:
- Staging model in delta/events_zone: invocation_enriched_stg (joins raw event stream to model_catalog, tenant metadata, and prefix_cache telemetry).
- Curated fact: tenant_model_variant_cost_facts (daily partitions) with columns: tenant_id, date, model_family, model_variant, route_id, invocation_count, token_in, token_out, gpu_seconds_est, raw_cost_usd, time_decay_weighted_cost_usd, prefix_cache_hits, avg_seq_len_50pct, percentile_95_latency_ms.
- Supporting dimension tables: dim_model_variant (stable model metadata + quantization profile), dim_route (route metadata + intent tags).
- dbt models: incremental materializations, CI checks, and snapshotting for dim_model_variant.
- Airflow DAGs to orchestrate nightly build and ad-hoc backfills.

Key modeling decisions:
- Partition by date and tenant_id; cluster by route_id and model_variant to optimize route-level aggregations.
- Time-decay: exponential decay (lambda tuned via experiment) applied to sequences of invocations within a 7-day window to avoid double-counting long-running journeys. Decay implementation belongs in the dbt model using window functions and a leaky-bucket state variable stored as part of the incremental state.
- Cost attribution: derive GPU seconds using token counts and model-specific tokens-per-second profile from runtime logs. Convert to USD using nightly price sheet (cost center) to keep estimates stable for dashboards.

Non-goals: this ticket does not change billing systems or invoice outputs. It focuses on analytics-only curated tables and dashboards.

Success metrics:
- New dashboards reduce time-to-answer for model-variant cost attribution from ~3d to <1h for an analyst.
- Less than 5% delta vs sample-based ground truth experiments for top-10 tenants after tuning.
- Nightly build completes within 90 minutes for the full tenant set (post-optimizations).
